problem.passage:
A vertical tower stands on level ground. Point $P$ is on the ground $25$ meters from the base $B$ of the tower. From $P$, the angle of elevation to the top $T$ of the tower is $60^\circ$.

What is the height of the tower, in meters?
problem.stimulus: A vertical tower stands on level ground. Point $P$ is on the ground $25$ meters from the base $B$ of the tower. From $P$, the angle of elevation to the top $T$ of the tower is $60^\circ$.
problem.question: What is the height of the tower, in meters?
problem.explanation: 삼각형 $TBP$는 $B$에서 직각인 직각삼각형이고, $P$에서의 고도각이 $60^\circ$이므로 $\tan 60^\circ = \dfrac{TB}{BP}$이다. $\tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$, $BP = 25$이므로 $TB = 25\sqrt{3}$ 미터이다. 따라서 정답은 A번이다.
problem.explanationEn: Triangle $TBP$ is a right triangle with the right angle at $B$, and the angle of elevation at $P$ is $60^\circ$, so $\tan 60^\circ = \dfrac{TB}{BP}$. Since $\tan 60^\circ = \sqrt{3}$ and $BP = 25$, the height is $TB = 25\sqrt{3}$ meters. Choice B results from using $\dfrac{BP}{TB}$ instead of $\dfrac{TB}{BP}$. Therefore, the correct answer is A.
